test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the export and import of goods (in lakh numbers) of a company in consecutive years 2018 to 2022. What will be the growth percentage for imports from 2018 to 2021? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d934c21c12d35b0150977199898086e8b714d1e4eff828a7a4af47e8e32dc246.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Imports in 2018 = 60 lakh

Imports in 2021 = 110 lakh

**Formula Used:**

Growth Percentage = ((Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value) × 100

**Calculation:**

Initial Value = 60 lakh

Final Value = 110 lakh

Growth Percentage = ((110 - 60) / 60) × 100

⇒ Growth Percentage = (50 / 60) × 100

⇒ Growth Percentage = 0.8333 × 100

⇒ Growth Percentage = 83.33%

**The growth percentage for imports from 2018 to 2021 is 83.33%.**
